Melbourne Regional Chamber
05 October 2023 | Melbourne Oceanfront, FL
On October 5, 2023, Occams Advisory Inc. proudly participated in the 'Good Morning Space Coast' breakfast at the Crowne Plaza Melbourne Oceanfront, FL. From 7:45 AM to 9:00 AM EDT, this event offered a unique confluence of networking and insightful discussions.
Set against the stunning oceanfront backdrop, the event provided a perfect stage for professionals to engage and connect. Attendees enjoyed a morning filled with vibrant conversations, exchanging ideas and building valuable connections in a welcoming and professional atmosphere.
A major highlight was our feature presentation on Free Facebook Ads. This session delved into the effective strategies of digital marketing, emphasizing how businesses can utilize social media, particularly Facebook, for greater reach and impact. Our experts shared practical insights and tips, showcasing how targeted advertising on Facebook can be a game-changer for businesses of all sizes.
The event attracted a diverse mix of entrepreneurs, seasoned business professionals, and individuals at the start of their careers, all eager to learn and network. The 'Good Morning Space Coast' breakfast served as an excellent platform for attendees to expand their knowledge and professional networks.
Occams Advisory Inc.'s participation in this event underscored our commitment to empowering businesses and individuals through knowledge sharing and fostering collaborative opportunities. It was an enriching experience that not only contributed to our growth but also allowed us to be part of the dynamic evolution in the world of digital marketing.
Reflecting on the event, we are excited about the new connections formed and the insights gained. The 'Good Morning Space Coast' breakfast was more than just an event; it was a step forward in our journey of continuous learning and professional development.

World Culture Festival by Art of Living
29 September 2023 | Washington DC
Occams Advisory Inc. took great pride in sponsoring the 4th World Cultural Festival, an immersive three-day extravaganza that seamlessly blended deep meditation, music, dance, and inspirational talks. This extraordinary celebration, held on the iconic National Mall in Washington, DC, from September 29th to October 1st, 2023, marked a historic gathering of individuals from diverse backgrounds, united in the pursuit of joy, peace, and community.
Our leadership and management teams, accompanied by their cherished family members, were in attendance to partake in this remarkable cultural experience. The festival offered a sensory feast for all, with live music spanning genres from hip hop to classical to world music, accompanied by the mesmerizing spins of whirling dervishes and the soul-stirring stomps of flamenco dancers. International food trucks added to the culinary delights, offering a wide array of dishes to savor and enjoy.
A highlight of the festival was the collective yoga flow that united thousands, emphasizing the importance of physical and mental well-being. The 4th World Cultural Festival embodied the essence of unity, cultural diversity, and the power of meditation to create a harmonious world.
As a sponsor, Occams Advisory Inc. supported this exceptional celebration that transcended borders and brought people together in the spirit of oneness. We were thrilled to be part of an event that promoted joy, peace, and community on a global scale. Stay tuned for updates and recap videos to relive the magical moments of the Art of Living's World Culture Festival 2023.
In the meantime, we extend an invitation to join the Art of Living's Part 1 course, where you can discover SKY Breath Meditation, an evidence-based technique designed to reduce stress and harmonize emotions. At Occams Advisory Inc., we believe in promoting well-being, both personally and professionally, and are committed to supporting initiatives that align with our values of unity and personal growth.

South Florida Chamber of Commerce
25 September 2023 | Marriott N. Andrews, FL
Occams Advisory Inc. assumed the prestigious role of Title Sponsor and exhibited at the South Florida Chamber of Commerce B2B Expo, a significant event held on September 25th, 2023. The event took place at the Marriott N. Andrews, located at 6650 N. Andrews Ave, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33309.
Our involvement as the Title Sponsor showcased our unwavering commitment to empowering businesses in South Florida and beyond. We were dedicated to helping businesses understand and maximize their employee retention tax credit, a critical financial benefit that can significantly impact their bottom line.
Our booth at the expo served as a hub for knowledge-sharing and engagement. We actively interacted with attendees, providing insights and guidance on harnessing the benefits of the employee retention tax credit. Our experts were on hand to answer questions, offer solutions, and foster valuable connections within the local business community.
Occams Advisory Inc. understands the importance of events like the South Florida Chamber of Commerce B2B Expo in promoting economic growth and prosperity. Our sponsorship and active participation highlighted our commitment to supporting local businesses and helping them thrive in today's competitive landscape.
We were thrilled to be part of this dynamic event and share our expertise with businesses eager to optimize their financial strategies. As the Title Sponsor, we emphasized our dedication to the success of the local business community and looked forward to continued opportunities to collaborate, educate, and contribute to the region's economic growth.

44th Hemispheric Congress
18 September 2023 | Miami Beach Convention Center
Occams Advisory Inc. was honored to sponsor and actively participate in CAMACOL's 44th Hemispheric Congress of Latin Chambers of Commerce and Industry and the World Trade Center Miami's 25th Americas Food & Beverage Show. This prestigious event took place at the Miami Beach Convention Center from September 18th to 20th, 2023, with the closing gala festivities planned for September 20th at Port Miami.
Our Deputy CEO, David King, represented Occams Advisory Inc. at this vibrant and internationally recognized gathering. David's presence added immense value to our participation, as he had the opportunity to connect with a diverse range of professionals and experts from various industries.
David King's contribution went beyond networking; he had the privilege of delivering a compelling 20-to-30-minute presentation on the topic of employee retention tax credit. His expertise in this area resonated with the audience, and his insights provided valuable guidance to attendees seeking to optimize their businesses.
Occams Advisory Inc. is committed to supporting events like CAMACOL's Hemispheric Congress and the Americas Food & Beverage Show, which promote cross-industry collaboration and knowledge sharing. Our sponsorship and active participation exemplify our dedication to fostering connections and contributing to the growth and success of businesses within our network.
We are thrilled with the positive impact David King made at this event and the opportunities it provided to showcase our expertise. We look forward to continuing our engagement with industry professionals and organizations to drive innovation and excellence in the business landscape. The CAMACOL and World Trade Center Miami event was a testament to the vibrancy and potential of the global business community, and we are proud to have been a part of it.

The American Agents Alliance Conference & Expo
14 September 2023 | California
Occams Advisory Inc. was excited to be an active participant at the American Agents Alliance Conference & Expo, a prominent industry event that unfolded from September 14th to 16th, 2023. The event was hosted at the stunning JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa in Palm Desert, California, known for its luxurious ambiance and top-notch amenities.
Our dedicated team, led by VP of Client Origination, Vardhman Shah, took center stage at booth number 100, where we had the opportunity to showcase Occams Advisory Inc.'s expertise, services, and commitment to excellence. Vardhman Shah's presence added a touch of enthusiasm and professionalism, making our booth a hub of networking and engagement.
The American Agents Alliance Conference & Expo provided a fertile ground for connecting with industry peers, forging new relationships, and strengthening existing partnerships. We engaged in meaningful conversations, shared insights, and explored collaboration opportunities that can drive innovation and growth within the industry.
At Occams Advisory Inc., we understand the significance of industry events like this in fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange. Our participation at this event reaffirmed our commitment to building enduring relationships and contributing to the advancement of the industry.
We look forward to continued engagement with our industry peers, as we believe in the power of partnerships to drive positive change and innovation. The American Agents Alliance Conference & Expo was a testament to the industry's vitality and potential, and we are excited to be a part of its bright future.

Greater Hollywood Chamber of Commerce
14 September 2023 | Florida
Occams Advisory Inc. was honored to be a corporate sponsor at a significant industry event hosted at the Abiaka Hard Rock Hotel & Casino, located at 1 Seminole Way, Hollywood, FL 33314, on Thursday, September 14, 2023. Our Deputy CEO, David King, represented our organization with utmost grace and enthusiasm, making our presence felt among esteemed industry peers and leaders.
The event, held under the theme "Lunch On," provided a unique platform for networking and knowledge exchange. Occams Advisory Inc. seized this opportunity to connect with industry leaders, engage in meaningful discussions, and share valuable insights that can drive success in the business landscape.
As a corporate sponsor, we demonstrated our commitment to supporting and contributing to the growth and development of the industry. Our participation at the Abiaka Hard Rock Hotel & Casino event reaffirmed our dedication to building strong relationships within our professional community.
Occams Advisory Inc. believes in the power of collaboration and knowledge-sharing, and this event allowed us to connect with like-minded individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation. We had a fantastic time connecting, learning, and contributing to the event's success, and we look forward to more opportunities to engage with our industry peers in the future.

North Phoenix Chamber of Commerce - Wine Bar Networking
06 September 2023 | Arizona
Amber Kellogg, the Assistant Vice President of Client Relations at Occams Advisory, recently represented our organization at the North Phoenix Chamber of Commerce Wine Bar Party. Amber's professional journey is a testament to her unique and diverse experiences. She has spent decades honing her skills in the realms of luxury fashion and global banking, offering a distinctive blend of creative problem-solving and well-structured solution mapping.
In her role as AVP of Client Relations at Occams Advisory, Amber excels in originating new client relationships and nurturing existing ones. Her approach to problem-solving is characterized by a client-centric mindset, perfectly aligned with Occams' core philosophy.
The North Phoenix Chamber of Commerce Wine Bar Party provided an ideal platform for Amber to connect with fellow business professionals and community leaders. The event's mission, centered on connecting leaders and influencers to drive positive change, resonated with Amber's own commitment to facilitating business growth and transformation.
Occams Advisory is proud to have Amber Kellogg as part of our team, contributing her wealth of experience and distinctive problem-solving approach to benefit our clients and partners. Her presence at events like the North Phoenix Chamber of Commerce Wine Bar Party underscores our dedication to fostering meaningful connections within the business community.

‘X’ Marks the Spot by Experior Financial Group
22 August 2023 | Toronto
Occams Advisory Inc. had the privilege of attending Experior Financial Group Inc.'s prestigious in-person convention, 'X Mark's the Spot,' held from August 22nd to 24th, 2023, at the Hamilton Convention Center in Ontario, Canada. Our distinguished delegation included Vardhman Shah, Client Origination Head; Josh Westfall, Chief Revenue Officer; and Mukarram Dhorajiwala, Head of Marketing and Branding.
This eagerly awaited event served as a dynamic platform for industry leaders, professionals, and visionaries to converge, sharing profound insights, strategies, and inspiration within the financial services industry. 'X Mark's the Spot' not only celebrated the achievements of Experior Financial Group Inc. but also fostered a vibrant exchange of ideas and knowledge among industry peers.
The convention featured accomplished industry leaders who illuminated their personal journeys, providing attendees with invaluable advice on excelling in the financial services sector. With a steadfast commitment to helping participants reach their full potential, 'X Mark's the Spot' was designed to empower individuals with the tools and knowledge essential for achieving exceptional success in their businesses.
At Occams Advisory Inc., we recognize the importance of engaging with industry events like 'X Mark's the Spot' to stay at the forefront of industry trends, establish meaningful connections, and gain fresh perspectives. Our participation in this event reinforces our dedication to providing our clients with the best-in-class insights and strategies necessary for their financial success. We are proud to have been part of this enriching experience and look forward to continuing our journey of growth and excellence.

Business Expo - Small-Business Summit
03 June 2023 | New York City
Welcome to Occams Advisory Inc.'s event page, where we proudly showcase our participation in the Small Business Summit held at the Hilton Convention Center Midtown, NYC, on June 3rd, 2023. At this event, we hosted a valuable 30-minute workshop titled "Unlocking Tax Credit Benefits for Small Business Owners."
Our workshop delved into the intricacies of tax credits, offering essential insights for small business owners. We provided guidance on identifying, applying for, and maximizing tax credit benefits to boost your bottom line. It was an opportunity for attendees to gain a competitive edge in their financial strategies.
Occams Advisory Inc. is committed to empowering entrepreneurs and small business owners with knowledge and resources to thrive. We believe in supporting you every step of the way in your journey to success. Stay tuned for more informative events and workshops as we continue to share expertise and help you unlock the full potential of your business.

Mastering IRS Updates & Corporate Transparency: Insights from Occams  Advisory
May 12 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar focuses on the latest IRS updates for the current year and explores various aspects of the Corporate Transparency Act (CTA). Amber introduces the expert panel from Occams Advisory, including Anupam (CEO and Founder), David King (Deputy CEO), Nadine (Corporate Counsel), Priyanka (AVP Finance), Rajat (VP,) and Josh (Chief Revenue Officer). Each panelist shares their expertise on the CTA and highlights its benefits for businesses filing with Occams Advisory. The webinar also sheds light on critical topics such as the Congressional Constituent Request, the process of suing the IRS for refund processing, and key compliance requirements and deadlines for Beneficial Ownership Transparency Reporting. With insights from affiliates and clients who participated, the session emphasizes how Occams Advisory’s advanced AI tools and streamlined compliance processes ensure a win-win outcome for businesses.

Unlocking Tax Credits: Small Biz Benefits Unveiled!
Aug 02 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
The webinar discussed the Employee Retention Credit (ERC) for small businesses, a tax credit available to those who retained employees during COVID-19. Experts emphasized the importance of seeking accurate information due to the process's complexity.
Businesses must tie factors like revenue decline to executive orders to qualify. Partnering with knowledgeable experts can help navigate the process effectively. Many businesses may qualify, but face challenges in applying alone. Deadlines vary for different quarters in 2020 and 2021. Overall, the webinar aimed to provide clarity and assistance to small businesses seeking to maximize the ERC.

Mastering Audit Advisory & R&D Credits with the Experts at Occams
Feb 07 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
this webinar focused on navigating opportunities within the Affiliate Weekly program, with a primary discussion on the Audit Advisory and Research & Development (R&D) Tax Credits. Presenters Amber, Josh, and John provide an in-depth look at how businesses can benefit from these services.
The webinar covers the importance of compliance, the process for submitting leads for audit advisory and R&D, and the specific target markets for R&D tax credits. The presenters emphasize the importance of building relationships with business owners to address their challenges and provide solutions through Occams Advisory services. Additionally, upcoming webinar topics and enhancements to the affiliate portal are previewed, highlighting ongoing training and development opportunities for affiliates.

Unlocking Tax Credit Opportunities: A Comprehensive Guide for Affiliate Partners
Feb 14 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar provides insights into a detailed discussion on eligibility analysis, compliance validation, and fee structures for services related to tax credits such as ERC (Employee Retention Credit) and R&D (Research and Development) tax credit. It outlines the process, requirements, and fees involved in assisting clients with eligibility assessments, compliance validations, and audit advisories.
The discussion delves into various industries and criteria for qualifying for R&D tax credits, emphasizing the importance of understanding clients' businesses and identifying potential leads. Additionally, it highlights upcoming challenges for affiliate partners to submit viable leads and emphasizes the significance of updating information on the affiliate portal for effective communication and engagement.

Occams Advisory Offers Crucial Insights for ERC Filing Amid IRS Scrutiny
Feb 28 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar session discussed a complimentary service called Tax Now, aimed at aiding clients with Employee Retention Credit (ERC) filings. The speakers detailed the steps for signing up, emphasizing its real-time alert feature to prepare for potential audits. Attendees are urged to encourage clients to register, highlighting the IRS's increased scrutiny on ERC claims.
Amidst discussion of a leads challenge, questions arise regarding PEO fund disbursement and ERC clients awaiting approval. Plans to remind clients to amend tax returns and support for affiliates are underscored. Despite minor technical glitches, the session concludes with gratitude for participation and an invitation to future webinars, fostering engagement and support within the community.

Webinar Highlights Tax Compliance Strategies for Small Business Owners
Mar 20 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this webinar, we discusses the process of submitting tax amendments and emphasizes the importance of staying tax compliant. We explain how to initiate the process, highlighting the convenience of using the online portal or sharing a QR code. The speaker also introduces a partnership with Tax Now, which offers real-time tracking of ERC refunds and proactive alerts for tax-related issues.
We stress the significance of client outreach and follow-up to ensure participation in Tax Now's services. Overall, the webinar aims to educate affiliates on assisting small business clients with tax compliance and maximizing their benefits, concluding with a call to action for continued engagement and support.

Insights from Occams Advisory's Webinar on Business Solutions and the Self-Employment Tax Credit
Mar 27 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar highlights a discussion led by Chris, Occams Advisory's National Sales Director, and Amber, regarding various business solutions offered by the company. Chris shares insights on the self-employment tax credit (STC), emphasizing its potential benefits for self-employed individuals impacted by COVID-19.
He emphasizes the importance of networking, referrals, and proactive outreach in leveraging these solutions effectively. The discussion also touches on audit advisory and tax amendments to ensure tax compliance. Throughout the webinar, the focus remains on empowering affiliates to foster mutually beneficial relationships and drive success through innovative solutions. Attendees are encouraged to engage in discussions and leverage OccamsAdvisory's expertise to amplify their brands and achieve growth.

Interactive Webinar Provides Insights on Tax Credits, and Effective Communication Strategies with Clients
Apr 03 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar session discusses documentation requirements for claiming COVID-related benefits and addressing tax-related queries. Participants inquire about proof of COVID diagnosis or symptoms for self-employment claims, alongside queries on tax credits and refunds.
The conversation underscores the importance of communication, urging attendees to engage, ask questions, and provide feedback for a successful experience. Hosts express gratitude to participants and support staff, emphasizing the commitment to providing a platform for excellence and knowledge sharing. The session concludes with a reminder of the recurring webinar schedule and appreciation for participant involvement.

Navigating the Road to Excellence with ERC and R&D Tax Credits
Apr 17 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
The Webinar begins with casual interactions among participants, including a music-sharing activity to engage attendees as they join. The conversation shifts towards technical aspects of business incentives like the Employee Retention Credit (ERC) and R&D tax credits.
Detailed explanations are provided on eligibility, application processes, and benefits of these credits. Amber and Rajat, discuss the importance of timely applications and strategic planning for businesses to maximize benefits. The webinar is interactive, with opportunities for questions and clarifications, aiming to equip affiliates with knowledge and tools to assist their clients effectively.

Occams Advisory Empowers Affiliates with Comprehensive Tax Insights and Strategic Guidance
Feb 24 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this comprehensive presentation, Amber E Kellogg from Occams Advisory delivers detailed insights into tax amendments, deadlines, required documentation, and pricing structures for both 2020 and 2021. She emphasizes the importance of compliance and provides a breakdown of audit advisory services aimed at ensuring clients' tax compliance amidst IRS scrutiny.
Amber also highlights the significance of cross-selling opportunities for affiliates, offering a glimpse into Occams Advisory's diverse range of services beyond ERC. The session concludes with an invitation for feedback, emphasizing ongoing education and support for affiliates. Through clear explanations and strategic guidance, the Webinar aims to equip affiliates with the knowledge and tools needed to navigate complex tax landscapes effectively.

Enhancing Affiliate Engagement with New Portal Features and Emphasizing Tax Compliance
May 01 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar focuses on various topics related to affiliate marketing and client management for Occams Advisory. During the webinar, Amber introduces features of the affiliate portal designed to streamline the management of client leads, documents, and communications.
Detailed explanations and demonstrations are provided on how to navigate and utilize the portal effectively, including sending agreements, managing opportunities, and uploading necessary documents. Additionally, the webinar discusses the importance of tax compliance and introduces tools like Tax Now for monitoring IRS processing statuses. The session encourages interactive participation from affiliates, offering a platform for questions and emphasizing the importance of feedback for ongoing improvements.

A Breakdown of the Corporate Transparency Act referring to the Fincen.gov
May 12 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This webinar provides an in-depth understanding of the Corporate Transparency Act (CTA), outlining who must comply and how filing for Beneficial Ownership Information Reporting (BOIR) with Occams Advisory can be highly advantageous for businesses. The session features our Group CEO, who offers a comprehensive breakdown of the BOIR process and its implications. David King, Deputy CEO, expands on the reporting requirements and emphasizes the serious consequences of non-compliance.
The webinar also addresses recent legal updates surrounding BOIR, with Amber introducing Occams Advisory’s innovative solution: the Self-Service Software Solution, designed to simplify the compliance process. The session concluded with an engaging Q&A segment, where SBAM members had the opportunity to interact with the expert panel from Occams Advisory.

The 2025 ERC Deadline is here: Exclusive Webinar Highlights for Business Owners
Mar 06 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
Explore essential insights from our expert-led webinar that delves into the nuances of claiming the Employee Retention Credit (ERC) for 2021. This session is crucial for business owners aiming to navigate the complexities of the ERC process before the April 2025 deadline. Learn from industry experts as they outline eligibility requirements, necessary documentation, and strategic advice to ensure you maximize your potential refunds under the CARES Act. Whether you're new to ERC or seeking to enhance your understanding, this webinar provides valuable guidance to help you secure and optimize your claims, ensuring no funds are left on the table.

Uncopyable Women In Sales By Kay Miller
Jun 26 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this episode, Kay interviews Amber Kellogg, VP of Affiliate Origination and Management at Occams Advisory. Amber shares her remarkable career journey, starting from managing divisions at The Limited, including Victoria's Secret, to becoming a pivotal figure in relationship management at J.P. Morgan Chase and eventually landing at Occams Advisory.
Her story highlights overcoming challenges in a male-dominated industry and the importance of continuous self-improvement. Amber emphasizes that in sales at Occams Advisory, personal integrity and relationship-building are as crucial as the services offered, reflecting her philosophy that success hinges on both the product and the person selling it.

Learning Never Stops: Anupam Satyasheel Stresses Importance of Adaptability and Collaboration
Mar 08 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this insightful conversation, Anupam Satyasheel, a seasoned business leader, shares invaluable insights on the critical importance of continuous learning and adaptability in today's rapidly evolving business landscape.
Anupam emphasizes the necessity for entrepreneurs and business leaders to stay updated with industry trends and developments, particularly amidst the fast pace of technological advancements. He highlights the transformative power of investing in reputable sources and paid subscriptions for enhanced insights.
Furthermore, Anupam discusses the significance of surrounding oneself with complementary talents and the need to anticipate and prepare for unforeseen events, or "black swan" events, that can disrupt businesses. Through anecdotes and reflections, he underscores the vital role of innovation, collaboration, and a thirst for knowledge in navigating uncertainties and driving sustained success in the ever-changing business world.

Empowering businesses to navigate complex financial landscapes with ease
May 16 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
Anupam Satyasheel, our visionary Founder & CEO, and Josh Westfall, our astute Chief Revenue Officer, had an enlightening conversation. They unpacked the intricacies of FPSO (Full and Partial Suspension Order) and SDGR (Significant Decline in Gross Receipt) and their instrumental role in eligibility for Employee Retention Tax Credit. A crucial piece of knowledge that can empower businesses to navigate complex financial landscapes with ease.

CEO Anupam Satyasheel Reveals Secrets Behind Occams Advisory's Rapid Growth: Customer-Centric Approach Key to Success
Sep 16 2018 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In a revealing interview, Anupam Satyasheel, CEO of Ockham's Advisory, shares the journey behind the company's remarkable growth trajectory. From $410,000 in 2014 to a projected $7-8 million in 2017, the firm's revenue surge underscores its commitment to customer satisfaction.
Satyasheel attributes their success to a client-centric ethos, with 70% of revenue stemming from repeat business. He emphasizes the significance of offering comprehensive services and fostering strong client relationships, often leveraging referrals over traditional marketing.
Satyasheel also delves into the importance of robust internal processes for scalability, despite the challenges of managing a geographically dispersed team.

Unlocking Pandemic Relief: ERC Explained on Radio Show.
May 23 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In a lively radio discussion, Amber E Kellogg shed light on the Employee Retention Credit (ERC) and its potential benefits for businesses navigating the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic.
Hosted on a Saturday morning show, the conversation delves into the intricacies of ERC eligibility, clarifying misconceptions and addressing common concerns. Amber Kellogg, from Occams Advisory, breaks down the criteria for ERC qualification, emphasizing that even profitable businesses during the pandemic may still be eligible. The conversation also addresses the interaction between ERC and other relief programs like the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP).
Listeners are encouraged to reach out for further assistance, as the experts aim to empower businesses with crucial tax knowledge and guidance during these uncertain times

Insider's View: Anupam Satyasheel Reveals Secrets to Business Success
Mar 07 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this insightful conversation, Anupam Satyasheel, shares how his firm attracts clients primarily through referrals from satisfied customers. He emphasizes the role of luck when preparation meets opportunity in their success.
Occams specializes in providing advisory services to small and medium-sized businesses, addressing common challenges such as profit generation, business expansion, and tax optimization. Many clients lack expertise in crucial areas like accounting and accessing capital, highlighting the need for professional guidance.
While Occams boasts expertise across various industries, they primarily serve service-based businesses, including technology and healthcare sectors. Anupam believes that embracing digital transformation is essential for businesses to thrive in today's competitive landscape. Through his holistic approach, Anupam aims to empower businesses and drive sustainable growth.

Former Wall Street Banker Turned Entrepreneur Anupam Satyasheel Shares Tough Decisions and Strategies for Business Growth
Apr 25 2019 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
Anupam Satyasheel, a former Wall Street investment banker turned successful entrepreneur, shares his journey, highlighting pivotal tough decisions he faced along the way. From breaking his own hiring rules to offering a friend a job to diversifying his company's services for more stable income,
Anupam provides valuable insights into the challenges and triumphs of entrepreneurship. He emphasizes the importance of embracing humility and being willing to adapt, even if it means stepping out of one's comfort zone. Through thoughtful decision-making strategies and a commitment to leveraging technology effectively,
Anupam demonstrates how resilience and vision can lead to sustainable business growth. Readers gain practical wisdom and inspiration for their own entrepreneurial endeavors.

Founder Discusses Challenges of Hyper-Growth and Commitment to Social Impact in B2B Podcast Interview
Apr 18 2018 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this insightful B2B podcast episode, host James Carberry interviews Anupam Satyasheel, founder and chief enterprise officer at Occams Advisory, delving into the intricacies of managing hyper-growth in business.
Anupam candidly discusses four key challenges faced during rapid expansion: accepting imperfection, retaining talent, managing cash flow, and navigating complex regulations. Beyond business, Anupam shares a deeply personal commitment to philanthropy, highlighting his involvement in a charity dedicated to children's social, psychological, and educational needs across seven countries. His inspiring journey from humble beginnings in rural India underscores his passion for leaving a positive impact on the world. Listeners gain valuable insights into the dynamic interplay between business growth, social responsibility, and personal fulfillment.

Virtual-First Strategies and Talent Optimization: CEO Shares Insights on Enhancing Business Efficiency
Mar 07 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this insightful discussion, CEO Anupam Satyasheel shares strategies for businesses to enhance efficiency and competitiveness. He emphasizes the importance of adopting a virtual-first approach, leveraging technology, and being selective when hiring talent.
Anupam highlights the significance of timing in optimizing work output and fostering transparent metrics for tracking progress. Instead of simply firing employees who may not fit, he advocates for clear conversations to help them find better opportunities elsewhere.
Anupam also explores the potential of tapping into global talent pools, such as in India. Overall, his insights provide valuable guidance for organizations aiming to thrive in today's dynamic business landscape.

Unlocking Financial Support: Small Businesses Explore Employee Retention Tax Credits
Dec 14 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
Tune into the Greater South Florida Chamber radio program as host John Kroll interviews Josh Westfall from Occams Advisory to demystify the Employee Retention Credit (ERC) program for small businesses.
This program, born from the 2020 CARES Act, rewards businesses for retaining employees during the COVID-19 pandemic. Unlike PPP loans, ERC is a refundable tax credit based on wages paid to employees.
Westfall explains eligibility criteria, including significant declines in gross receipts or suspension orders due to the pandemic. Small businesses can receive up to $26,000 per employee, providing crucial financial support without repayment obligations. To explore qualifications and benefits, businesses are encouraged to contact Occams Advisory or visit their website.

Pandemic Challenges and Remote Work Revolution:  Anupam Satyasheel Discusses Changing Business Dynamics
Mar 08 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this enlightening discussion, Anupam Satyasheel delves into the transformative effects of the pandemic on business operations. He explores the evolving landscape of financial systems, citing challenges like inflation and the emergence of cryptocurrencies. Satyasheel emphasizes the shift towards decentralized workforces and questions traditional office-based practices due to remote work capabilities.
Drawing from real-world examples, he underscores the importance of companies adapting to retain talent and foster a culture of innovation. Through anecdotes from a conversation with a CPA firm principal, Satyasheel highlights the changing dynamics of employee loyalty and productivity in a remote work environment. Ultimately, he advocates for a reevaluation of traditional business paradigms to embrace the opportunities presented by the pandemic-induced changes.

Unlocking Business Potential: Understanding the Employee Retention Tax Credit (ERC) with Occams Advisory
Apr 17 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
The interview featuring David King from Occams Advisory, shedding light on the Employee Retention Tax Credit (ERC). In a conversation with radio hosts, King outlines the intricacies of ERC, emphasizing its role in rewarding businesses for retaining employees during the pandemic.
He clarifies misconceptions surrounding ERC, emphasizing it as a legitimate IRS program aimed at aiding businesses. The interview elucidates ERC's eligibility criteria, including W2 employee requirements and revenue decline benchmarks. Notably, it distinguishes ERC from the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), highlighting ERC's cash refund nature versus PPP's loan structure. Throughout, the interview advocates for businesses to leverage Occams Advisory's expertise in navigating ERC application processes, offering a glimpse into the program's potential benefits.

Rescued: Small Businesses Found Hope Through ERC
Dec 15 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this heartfelt conversation, Anupam Satyasheel sheds light on the challenges faced by small businesses burdened with high levels of debt. Amidst this financial distress, government aid emerges as a beacon of hope. Anupam shares touching anecdotes of businesses receiving relief checks, which bring about tears of happiness and relief.
These funds enable struggling businesses to retain their operations and support their employees, sparing them from the fear of unemployment. He emphasizes the profound reward of witnessing the positive impact of this assistance on both businesses and their employees. Additionally, Anupam extends a call to action, urging anyone aware of eligible businesses to explore the possibility of accessing this vital aid. Through empathy and support, these initiatives serve as lifelines for businesses navigating turbulent times.

Occams Advisory Promises Expert Help and Guarantee for Accuracy
Dec 15 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This Video highlights a Occams’ commitment to accuracy and reliability in helping people with their taxes. Anupam emphasizes the complexity of tax filing and the importance of getting it right, noting the involvement of tax attorneys and CPAs to ensure correctness every time.
He reassures clients by offering various assurances, including standing behind their work, providing all necessary documentation, and offering support in case of an audit. Furthermore, the service pledges to defend clients if needed and refund their share if any mistakes occur. This level of accountability is emphasized as uncommon in the financial services industry, underscoring the service's confidence in its ability to deliver accurate and dependable tax assistance to its clients.

Occams Insights Ensures Real Connections and Results for Clients' Claims Processing
Dec 15 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In their engaging discussion, Anupam Satyasheel highlights Occams’ unique approach to claims processing, ensuring clients receive their rightful funds while adhering to regulations. He stresses the importance of personal interaction, offering assurance that clients will speak with real people rather than automated systems.
With pride, he shares success stories, noting that two clients have successfully navigated audits and received their money as a result. This track record instills confidence in potential clients, assuring them of comprehensive support and answers to their queries. Despite Occams’ technological prowess, Anupam Satyasheel prioritizes genuine human interaction, even though Occams have developed a chatbot for addressing Employee Retention Credit (ERC) inquiries. Occams’ commitment to innovation and personalized attention sets them apart, effectively meeting clients' needs.

Revolutionizing SMBs: Anupam Satyasheel on Fintech, Values, and Occams Advisory's Impact
Jan 29 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
In this insightful podcast episode, Anupam Satyasheel, founder and CEO of Occams Advisory, delves into his entrepreneurial journey, beginning with his transition from Wall Street to establishing a firm that brings Fortune 500 expertise to SMBs.
He discusses the pivotal moments, including the 2008 financial crisis, that propelled him to start his venture, emphasizing fintech innovation, particularly in high-risk merchant accounts and multicurrency solutions. Anupam highlights the company's core values, underscoring a commitment to employee welfare, ethical business practices, and community support. He passionately shares how Occams Advisory stands out by not just focusing on profit but also on creating a positive impact, fostering a culture of gratitude, and continuously innovating to stay ahead in the ever-evolving fintech landscape.

Intrapreneurial Insights: Navigating Digital Marketing Evolution and Decoding the Nature of Money with Bitcoin
Oct 10 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This conversation captures a thought leadership discussion between Mukarram Dhorajiwala and Laura Often from Zen Media focused on two main paradigms: the evolving digital marketing landscape, particularly compliance and technology changes, and a deep dive into the nature of money, with a specific emphasis on Bitcoin.
Mukarram, acting as an intrapreneur, explores complex problems through the lens of exponential technologies, notably blockchain and cryptocurrency, asserting Bitcoin's unique value among these. He also discusses the conventional role of money, questioning its centralized nature and highlighting Bitcoin's potential to disrupt traditional financial systems. Additionally, the conversation touches on Mukarram’s background in finance and economics, his extensive self-driven research into monetary systems, and his intent to demystify the concept of money for the broader public.

Dynamic Leader Shares Insights on Excellence, Strategy, and Making a Positive Impact: A Deep Dive with David
Dec 22 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This Video features David King and Laura Often from Zen Video talking about professional experiences, personal stories, and perspectives on leadership and industry trends.
David, introduced as a dynamic and result-driven leader with a background in global banking, shares his journey and insights, emphasizing the importance of strategic thinking, client satisfaction, and dedication to excellence. David and Laura talk about thought leadership, media representation, and the challenges and opportunities in financial services. The dialogue also explores personal interests, volunteer work, and the impact of mentorship, showcasing a comprehensive view of professional achievements, leadership qualities, and the values that drive success in business and personal life.

Anupam Satyasheel on Transforming SMB Services with Occams Advisory: A Journey from Wall Street to Technology-Driven Solutions
Jan 29 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
A podcast episode from PayPod, hosted by Jacob Halal, who interviews Anupam Satyasheel, the founder and CEO of Occams Advisory. Anupam shares his journey from working on Wall Street to founding Occams Advisory in 2012, aiming to bring Fortune 500 expertise to SMBs.
He discusses the inspiration behind the company, its evolution, and the pivot from various business ideas to establishing a firm that offers a wide range of services, including investment banking, insurance, fintech platforms like Equip, and professional services. Anupam emphasizes the importance of being technology-driven, automating processes, and the company's unique approach to managing high-risk payment processing. He also highlights Occams Advisory's strong mission statement, culture of gratitude, and the principle-driven approach that has helped retain employees and satisfy clients.

John Bruner Sheds Light on R&D Tax Credits, AI's Role in Business Innovation, and Navigating Tax Legislation Changes
Feb 21 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
This thought leadership discussion introduces John Bruner and Laura Often from Zen Media and discusses the current focus and challenges in tax advisory, particularly in research and development (R&D) tax credits.
John Bruner shares insights into why businesses often miss out on R&D tax credits, the impact of AI on business innovation, and the specifics of recent legislative changes affecting tax strategies. The conversation also covers the importance of specialization in business today, the value of partnerships in the advisory sector, and John's professional pride in helping clients improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Navigating Small Business Taxes: Expert Advice and Strategies Unveiled
Mar 25 2024 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
A detailed conversation by Amber E Kellogg concerning tax considerations for small businesses. Amber emphasizes the importance of staying informed about tax deadlines, maintaining accurate records, and seeking professional assistance for complex tax situations.
She discusses various tax credits and deductions available to business owners, such as the Research and Development (R&D) credit, self-employment tax credit, and Employee Retention Credit (ERC). The conversation also delves into choosing between tax software and hiring a tax specialist, considering factors like complexity, cost, and long-term planning. Overall, it provides comprehensive insights into navigating tax obligations and maximizing benefits for small businesses.

Amber Kellogg at Occams Advisory: Bridging Innovation and Simplicity in Business Solutions
Nov 20 2023 | Podcast
Your browser does not support the video tag.
Episode Overview
An Interesting conversation between Amber E Kellogg and Laura Often from Zen Media, focusing on Amber's background, her role at Occams Advisory, and the services Occams provides. Amber shares her extensive career across different sectors, emphasizing her problem-solving skills and passion for businesses.
She discusses Occams Advisory's ethos, which is inspired by Occams Razor, aiming to provide simple solutions to complex problems. Amber highlights her transition to focusing on affiliate partnerships while still engaging in client management. The conversation covers market trends, the impact of the pandemic on businesses, the importance of digital transformation, AI, and maintaining a human touch in services. Amber passionately speaks about the challenges their clients face, such as market volatility, digital transformation, and the need for effective financial planning and capital management. She also touches on corporate social responsibility and Occams Advisory's global impact, showcasing her commitment to both professional and ethical standards in business.

Our Empowered Team
We believe in engaging people who are instinctively inclined to support our
                        clients and yet challenge
                        them to superior levels. Our people measure our success by a singular yardstick – the measurable
                        impact
                        of our services to our clients. We strive to build a work-culture where client’s success is
                        synonymous
                        with ours.
We believe that success is to do the right things for our clients, our people
                        and our communities.
                        Our
                        team consists of smart, driven individuals prioritizing output and getting work done. We
                        value the relationships that we build. Unless we can become an extension of our clients’ agenda and
                        expectations, we consider ourselves sub-optimal in our efforts. Our single-minded dedication to our
                        clients’ ends is the reason why our clients recommend us to others. People at Occams work hard but
                        try
                        not to take ourselves too seriously.
Read
                            More
Anupam Satyasheel
Founder & Group CEO
Anupam founded Occams Advisory in 2011 and has served as the CEO since
                                2012. Anupam has
                                advised
                                many
                                CEOs and boards. Under his leadership, Occams has achieved exceptional results for its
                                clients
                                across industries and geographies. Prior to founding Occams, Anupam spent over half a
                                decade
                                on
                                Wall
                                Street with names like Barclays, Merrill Lynch, ScotiaBank et al.
Anupam lives and works from Long Beach, CA with his physician wife and
                                two boys. He
                                spends
                                his
                                evenings balancing professional after-hours with baseball and golf with his boys,
                                culinary
                                experiments with his family and deep dive into books on growth, success, and
                                astrophysics.
                                Anupam
                                also serves on the boards of Child Literacy and The Blossom Project, charities dedicated
                                to
                                providing educational opportunities to children in need.

Our Empowered Team
We believe in engaging people who are instinctively inclined to support our
                        clients and yet challenge
                        them to superior levels. Our people measure our success by a singular yardstick – the measurable
                        impact
                        of our services to our clients. We strive to build a work-culture where client’s success is
                        synonymous
                        with ours.
We believe that success is to do the right things for our clients, our people
                        and our communities.
                        Our
                        team consists of smart, driven individuals prioritizing output and getting work done. We
                        value the relationships that we build. Unless we can become an extension of our clients’ agenda and
                        expectations, we consider ourselves sub-optimal in our efforts. Our single-minded dedication to our
                        clients’ ends is the reason why our clients recommend us to others. People at Occams work hard but
                        try
                        not to take ourselves too seriously.

Our Empowered Team
We believe in engaging people who are instinctively inclined to support our
                        clients and yet challenge
                        them to superior levels. Our people measure our success by a singular yardstick – the measurable
                        impact
                        of our services to our clients. We strive to build a work-culture where client’s success is
                        synonymous
                        with ours.
We believe that success is to do the right things for our clients, our people
                        and our communities.
                        Our
                        team consists of smart, driven individuals prioritizing output and getting work done. We
                        value the relationships that we build. Unless we can become an extension of our clients’ agenda and
                        expectations, we consider ourselves sub-optimal in our efforts. Our single-minded dedication to our
                        clients’ ends is the reason why our clients recommend us to others. People at Occams work hard but
                        try
                        not to take ourselves too seriously.

Our Empowered Team
We believe in engaging people who are instinctively inclined to support our
                        clients and yet challenge
                        them to superior levels. Our people measure our success by a singular yardstick – the measurable
                        impact
                        of our services to our clients. We strive to build a work-culture where client’s success is
                        synonymous
                        with ours.
We believe that success is to do the right things for our clients, our people
                        and our communities.
                        Our
                        team consists of smart, driven individuals prioritizing output and getting work done. We
                        value the relationships that we build. Unless we can become an extension of our clients’ agenda and
                        expectations, we consider ourselves sub-optimal in our efforts. Our single-minded dedication to our
                        clients’ ends is the reason why our clients recommend us to others. People at Occams work hard but
                        try
                        not to take ourselves too seriously.

Our Empowered Team
We believe in engaging people who are instinctively inclined to support our
                        clients and yet challenge
                        them to superior levels. Our people measure our success by a singular yardstick – the measurable
                        impact
                        of our services to our clients. We strive to build a work-culture where client’s success is
                        synonymous
                        with ours.
We believe that success is to do the right things for our clients, our people
                        and our communities.
                        Our
                        team consists of smart, driven individuals prioritizing output and getting work done. We
                        value the relationships that we build. Unless we can become an extension of our clients’ agenda and
                        expectations, we consider ourselves sub-optimal in our efforts. Our single-minded dedication to our
                        clients’ ends is the reason why our clients recommend us to others. People at Occams work hard but
                        try
                        not to take ourselves too seriously.

Strategic Leadership & Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the
                                strategic
                                direction of the
                                organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all
                                groups
                                align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.
View Members
Leadership Advisory Board for Scalability
(LABS)
LABS advises the SLAT on highest organizational priorities and
                                continuously
                                changing regulatory,
                                technological, and economic landscape. They provide insights and recommendations on how to
                                scale
                                the
                                organization effectively and efIiciently.
View Members
Management, Execution, and Tactical Scalability (METS)
This group is responsible for the dayto-day management of the
                                organization.
                                They execute the
                                strategies
                                set by the SLAT and advised by the LABS. They also handle tactical scalability, ensuring
                                that
                                the
                                organization can adapt and scale in response to changes in the business environment.
View Members
Scalability, Technology, Efficiency & Productivity (STEP)

Our Empowered Team
We believe in engaging people who are instinctively inclined to support our
                        clients and yet challenge
                        them to superior levels. Our people measure our success by a singular yardstick – the measurable
                        impact
                        of our services to our clients. We strive to build a work-culture where client’s success is
                        synonymous
                        with ours.
We believe that success is to do the right things for our clients, our people
                        and our communities.
                        Our
                        team consists of smart, driven individuals prioritizing output and getting work done. We
                        value the relationships that we build. Unless we can become an extension of our clients’ agenda and
                        expectations, we consider ourselves sub-optimal in our efforts. Our single-minded dedication to our
                        clients’ ends is the reason why our clients recommend us to others. People at Occams work hard but
                        try
                        not to take ourselves too seriously.

Strategic Leadership & Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the
                                strategic
                                direction of the
                                organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all
                                groups
                                align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.
View Members
Leadership Advisory Board for Scalability
(LABS)
LABS advises the SLAT on highest organizational priorities and
                                continuously
                                changing regulatory,
                                technological, and economic landscape. They provide insights and recommendations on how to
                                scale
                                the
                                organization effectively and efIiciently.
View Members
Management, Execution, and Tactical Scalability (METS)
This group is responsible for the dayto-day management of the
                                organization.
                                They execute the
                                strategies
                                set by the SLAT and advised by the LABS. They also handle tactical scalability, ensuring
                                that
                                the
                                organization can adapt and scale in response to changes in the business environment.

Aashish Makkar
MD Occams Capital Markets
Aashish brings over 20 years of executive experience to Occams Capital Partners’ leadership team. As Head of Investment Banking, he oversees client service and transaction execution across the firm and leads firm’s Debt Capital Advisory practice.
Aashish joined Occams Capital Partners from EA Markets, where he was responsible for developing new client relationships and overseeing strategic finance advisory and capital markets transaction execution. Previously, he held leveraged finance and capital markets advisory roles at Ondra Partners, UBS and Credit Suisse. He holds an MBA from The Fuqua School of Business at Duke University and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Maharishi Dayanand University in India.
Aashish lives in Princeton, NJ with his wife and two children.

Life Biography
Anupam Satyasheel is a forward-thinking entrepreneur and the Founder and CEO of Occams Advisory, a global financial advisory firm that champions the growth of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) across various sectors. With his leadership, Occams has garnered prestigious recognitions, including listings on the Inc Fastest 5000, FT America’s Fastest 500, and Fortune magazine’s 300 Most Innovative Companies.
Holding an MBA from New York University, with a semester at London Business School, Anupam’s academic pursuits in Finance & Economics have laid a solid foundation for his professional journey. His Wall Street tenure at renowned institutions like Barclays, Bank of America Merrill Lynch, and The Bank of Nova Scotia equipped him with the insights and experience to identify the unique challenges faced by SMEs, inspiring the creation of Occams Advisory. Beyond his corporate achievements, Anupam is deeply committed to social and educational initiatives. He serves as a co-founder and executive director of Child Literacy, actively contributing to projects that support educational opportunities for underprivileged children. His engagement with non-profit organizations emphasizes his dedication to leveraging business success for broader societal impact.
Residing in Long Beach, CA, with his family, Anupam leads a balanced life, dedicating his time to both his professional endeavors and personal interests. He actively participates in sports with his sons, experiments with cooking, and indulges in reading on topics ranging from personal growth to astrophysics. This harmonious blend of activities reflects his belief in the importance of continuous learning and self-improvement. Anupam’s multifaceted career, marked by significant achievements in the financial sector and impactful contributions to social causes, showcases his commitment to empowering SMEs and fostering educational opportunities. His leadership at Occams Advisory and his philanthropic efforts demonstrate a steadfast dedication to creating a legacy of innovation, empowerment, and sustainable success.

Life Biography
Mukarram Dhorajiwala is the Co-Founder of Minecodes, an ITeS company established in 2015, specializing in technology and knowledge outsourcing. In 2021, Mukarram led a strategic merger with Occams Advisory Inc., North America's fastest-growing MSME, driving the company to new heights.
Accolades and Impact: Under Mukarram's leadership, the company earned Fortune's distinguished award for "America's Most Innovative Companies 2023." This accolade reflects his dedication to business and brand development, and his ability to craft compelling narratives that resonate in today's dynamic business environment.
Versatile Expertise: With an extensive background in Business Development, Brand Development, Product Innovation, and Digital Business Strategy, Mukarram excels at navigating complexities and shaping transformative solutions. His diverse skills include Paid and Organic Marketing, Process Innovation, and comprehensive Product and Market Research.
Holistic Skill Set: Mukarram's expertise spans multiple disciplines, including Software and Web Development, Marketing, User Experience Design, Finance, and R&D. This comprehensive skill set allows him to approach challenges from various angles, turning obstacles into opportunities.
Thought Leadership: Beyond his executive role, Mukarram is a thought leader who shares insights on Bitcoin, human interactions, brand building, and technology through his Substack. He invites others to join him in a journey of continuous learning and thought-provoking discussions.
Educational Foundation: Mukarram holds a management degree with a major in Economics and Business Management from the University of Mumbai. This academic background informs his strategic approach to solving business challenges.
Passions and Personal Life: A devoted husband and doting father to a 3-year-old, Mukarram balances his professional life with a rich personal life. His passions include astrophysics, electronic music, breakthrough technology, economics, and politics. As a branding enthusiast, he finds joy in creating impactful narratives that resonate with discerning audiences.
Based Canada, Mukarram operates at the intersection of innovation and opportunity. Let's connect to explore cutting-edge business and technology.

Life Biography
Priyanka Bathwal fell in love with accounting in 2004, and since then, it's been a happily ever after story. Her passion for accounting stems from her curiosity to solve problems. As the AVP-Finance at Occams Advisory, she collaborates with senior management to oversee the company's finances, including budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and financial reporting. Priyanka completed her professional studies by passing the CPA exam in the USA and the Chartered Accountancy exam in India. Her experience in diversified roles such as tax specialist, statutory auditor, and financial analyst has given her a well-rounded perspective on financial management.
Dancing brings Priyanka joy and helps her stay fit. Although she considers herself a bad but enthusiastic painter and portraitist, she enjoys the creative process. Priyanka spends her weekends playing board games and socializing with friends. For her, there is no better feeling in the world than holding her adorable daughter. She feels blessed to have a loving husband and caring parents.

Life Biography
David exemplifies a leader focused on results and growth, blending strategic acumen with a track record of execution. Currently serving as the Deputy CEO at Occams Advisory, his extensive experience in global banking across Europe laid the foundation for his entrepreneurial journey in the United States.
David's lateral thinking adds valuable perspectives to our strategic vision, contributing significantly to our client's growth trajectory.
David is a strong believer in self growth and that to succeed one needs to constantly evolve and invest in self growth. He is an avid believer that whatever topic you wish to master from quantum physics to complicated financial models, someone "has come before you" and has invested thousands of man hours mastering the topic that you can read in a book in 10 hours or less. You do not need to be the pioneer, leverage masters in the topic.
Residing and operating from Sarasota, Florida, David embraces a multifaceted life. Beyond his professional endeavors, he cherishes his roles as a father to two boys, a devoted husband, a caring son, and an esteemed community leader.
David is an avid sports fan and enjoys nothing more than watching his sons from the side of the field. His favorite downtime is spending time in the tranquil stunning waters of the Gulf of Mexico in Florida.

Sunny Shekhar
Product Lead

CEO – India

Life Biography
Nitin Kumar Aggarwal is an accomplished entrepreneur and seasoned executive, currently serving as the CEO of Occams Advisory's India operations. Based in New Delhi, Nitin has significantly influenced the company's strategic direction, leading it to be recognized among Fortune's top 300 innovative companies and securing placements in FT America’s Fastest 500 and the Inc Fastest 5000 for four consecutive years.
Nitin's academic background is robust, completing his Accelerated General Management Program at the prestigious Indian Institute of Management – Ahmedabad. He also holds an MBA from UPES, Dehradun. His foundational training in Information Technology was acquired at the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad, where he completed his Bachelor of Technology.
Professionally, Nitin started his journey as a proprietor, launching Rishikon Solutions from a small home office and scaling it into a thriving business with a team of over 50, achieving top-tier affiliate status on Clickbank.com. His entrepreneurial spirit flourished further when he founded 247 Experts Pvt Ltd, transforming it from a modest team of six to a powerhouse of over hundred professionals and pioneering industry standard KPIs. Nitin has experience in a diverse array of industries, each enriching him with a unique blend of insights and expertise. His extensive involvement in various business sectors has endowed him with a rare and comprehensive business acumen.
At Occams Advisory, Nitin has been instrumental in setting up and architecting the Equipay platform, among other significant projects. His role at Occams not only encompasses technical excellence but also extends to financial planning, innovation, and strategic growth. His goal at Occams Advisory is to make it a tech-first company and set new standards.
Outside of his professional arena, Nitin likes to focus on his family, and the extended circle, and enjoys reading. He has keen interest in Indian mythology and Vedic origins. His personal life is deeply rooted in Dehradun, where he contributes to local community initiatives, showcasing a commitment to leveraging his business acumen for broader societal benefits.

Christopher Torres
Executive Advisor – Business Origination
Chris Torres has built his career through his market leading insights into client psychology and risk preferences. As a seasoned insurance professional, he is a veteran of financial services and an expert on the drivers of critical insurable risks that impact small and medium businesses. His ability to persuade and influence business leaders to decisions that are challenging in the short term but beneficial in the long term makes him a distinguished leader in this space.
At Occams, Chris leads a broad range of affiliates who seek and secure market expansion and business origination opportunities for Occams’ tax credit team. In his rather short tenure of just over two years, Chris has forged various crucial partnerships that have brought hundreds of clients and dozens of large ticket opportunities to Occams.
Chris lives and works in Phoenix, AZ with his family and has a national mandate for expanding Occams’ client serving business solutions.

Previously, Zidane led a design team at U-Studio, the in-house agency for Hindustan Unilever. There, Zidane oversaw impactful visual and marketing material creation for a vast portfolio of renowned brands like Dove, Pond's, and Pepsodent. Zidane's experience extends beyond leadership, with UI/UX design skills honed at Occams Advisory and graphic design expertise developed at Soundlines Group.
Zidane's background began in web development, building a strong foundation in building and visualizing digital experiences at Indoasian Buildcon Pvt. Ltd.
A highly motivated individual with a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating engaging and user-friendly experiences, Zidane's strengths lie in communication, collaboration, and project management, allowing for effective team leadership and exceptional results delivery.

Strategic Leadership &
Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the strategic direction of the
                        organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all groups
                        align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.
Strategic Leadership &
Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the strategic direction of the
                        organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all groups
                        align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.

Aashish Makkar
MD Occams Capital Markets
Aashish brings over 20 years of executive experience to Occams Capital Partners’ leadership team. As Head of Investment Banking, he oversees client service and transaction execution across the firm and leads firm’s Debt Capital Advisory practice.
Aashish joined Occams Capital Partners from EA Markets, where he was responsible for developing new client relationships and overseeing strategic finance advisory and capital markets transaction execution. Previously, he held leveraged finance and capital markets advisory roles at Ondra Partners, UBS and Credit Suisse. He holds an MBA from The Fuqua School of Business at Duke University and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Maharishi Dayanand University in India.
Aashish lives in Princeton, NJ with his wife and two children.

                                the

Strategic Leadership &
Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the strategic direction of the
                        organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all groups
                        align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.
Strategic Leadership &
Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the strategic direction of the
                        organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all groups
                        align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.

Aashish Makkar
MD Occams Capital Markets
Aashish brings over 20 years of executive experience to Occams Capital Partners’ leadership team. As Head of Investment Banking, he oversees client service and transaction execution across the firm and leads firm’s Debt Capital Advisory practice.
Aashish joined Occams Capital Partners from EA Markets, where he was responsible for developing new client relationships and overseeing strategic finance advisory and capital markets transaction execution. Previously, he held leveraged finance and capital markets advisory roles at Ondra Partners, UBS and Credit Suisse. He holds an MBA from The Fuqua School of Business at Duke University and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Maharishi Dayanand University in India.
Aashish lives in Princeton, NJ with his wife and two children.

Leadership Advisory Board for Scalability
(LABS)
LABS advises the SLAT on highest organizational priorities and continuously
                                changing regulatory,
                                technological, and economic landscape. They provide insights and recommendations on how to
                                scale
                                the
                                organization effectively and efIiciently.
View Members
Management, Execution, and Tactical Scalability (METS)
This group is responsible for the dayto-day management of the organization.
                                They execute the
                                strategies
                                set by the SLAT and advised by the LABS. They also handle tactical scalability, ensuring
                                that
                                the
                                organization can adapt and scale in response to changes in the business environment.
View Members
Scalability, Technology, Efficiency & Productivity (STEP)
This group focuses on the technological aspects of scalability agenda. They
                                work on improving ef
                                eficiency and productivity leveraging most effective and advanced technological adoption
                                across
                                aspects of the organization.
View Members

Anupam Satyasheel
Founder
Anupam founded Occams Advisory in 2011 and has served as the CEO since 2012.
                                        Anupam has advised
                                        many CEOs and boards. Under his leadership, Occams has achieved exceptional
                                        results for its clients
                                        across industries and geographies. Prior to founding Occams, Anupam spent over
                                        half a decade on Wall
                                        Street with names like Barclays, Merrill Lynch, Scotia Capital et al.
Anupam lives and works from Long Beach, CA with his physician wife and two
                                        boys. He spends his
                                        evenings balancing professional after-hours with baseball and golf with his
                                        boys, culinary
                                        experiments with his family and deep dive into books on growth, success, and
                                        astrophysics. Anupam
                                        also serves on the boards of Child Literacy and The Blossom Project, charities
                                        dedicated to
                                        providing educational opportunities to children in need.

Strategic Leadership &
Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the strategic direction of the
                        organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all groups
                        align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.
Strategic Leadership &
Articulate Thinking (SLAT)
This is the top-level leadership group responsible for setting the strategic direction of the
                        organization. They articulate the vision and mission of the organization and ensure that all groups
                        align with this strategic direction in belief and execution.

Aashish Makkar
MD Occams Capital Markets
Aashish brings over 20 years of executive experience to Occams Capital Partners’ leadership team. As Head of Investment Banking, he oversees client service and transaction execution across the firm and leads firm’s Debt Capital Advisory practice.
Aashish joined Occams Capital Partners from EA Markets, where he was responsible for developing new client relationships and overseeing strategic finance advisory and capital markets transaction execution. Previously, he held leveraged finance and capital markets advisory roles at Ondra Partners, UBS and Credit Suisse. He holds an MBA from The Fuqua School of Business at Duke University and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Maharishi Dayanand University in India.
Aashish lives in Princeton, NJ with his wife and two children.

Leadership Advisory Board for Scalability
(LABS)
LABS advises the SLAT on highest organizational priorities and continuously
                                changing regulatory,
                                technological, and economic landscape. They provide insights and recommendations on how to
                                scale
                                the
                                organization effectively and efIiciently.
View Members
Management, Execution, and Tactical Scalability (METS)
This group is responsible for the dayto-day management of the organization.
                                They execute the
                                strategies
                                set by the SLAT and advised by the LABS. They also handle tactical scalability, ensuring
                                that
                                the
                                organization can adapt and scale in response to changes in the business environment.
View Members
Scalability, Technology, Efficiency & Productivity (STEP)
This group focuses on the technological aspects of scalability agenda. They
                                work on improving ef
                                eficiency and productivity leveraging most effective and advanced technological adoption
                                across
                                aspects of the organization.
View Members

                                to capture, measure and enhance client experience journey.

Anupam Satyasheel
Founder
Anupam founded Occams Advisory in 2011 and has served as the CEO since 2012.
                                        Anupam has advised
                                        many CEOs and boards. Under his leadership, Occams has achieved exceptional
                                        results for its clients
                                        across industries and geographies. Prior to founding Occams, Anupam spent over
                                        half a decade on Wall
                                        Street with names like Barclays, Merrill Lynch, Scotia Capital et al.
Anupam lives and works from Long Beach, CA with his physician wife and two
                                        boys. He spends his
                                        evenings balancing professional after-hours with baseball and golf with his
                                        boys, culinary
                                        experiments with his family and deep dive into books on growth, success, and
                                        astrophysics. Anupam
                                        also serves on the boards of Child Literacy and The Blossom Project, charities
                                        dedicated to
                                        providing educational opportunities to children in need.
